# Experiment 5: Model-Size Identification

## Section 1: Clear workspace and load packages

```{r exp5-setup}
rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

library(combss)
library(abess)
library(L0Learn)
```

## Section 2: Locate CPLEX and define best-subset function

```{r exp5-cplex-function}
## ============================================================
## Locate CPLEX executable
##
## No external R files are sourced.
## ============================================================

find_cplex_executable <- function() {

  candidates <- character(0)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Check system PATH
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  path_cplex <- unname(
    Sys.which("cplex")
  )

  if (
    length(path_cplex) > 0 &&
    nzchar(path_cplex)
  ) {

    candidates <- c(
      candidates,
      path_cplex
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Check CPLEX environment variables
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  env <- Sys.getenv()

  env_names <- grep(
    "^CPLEX_STUDIO_DIR",
    names(env),
    value = TRUE
  )


  if (
    length(env_names) > 0
  ) {

    for (
      env_name in env_names
    ) {

      studio_dir <- env[
        env_name
      ]

      if (
        nzchar(studio_dir)
      ) {

        candidates <- c(
          candidates,
          Sys.glob(
            file.path(
              studio_dir,
              "cplex",
              "bin",
              "*",
              "cplex"
            )
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common macOS locations
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  mac_patterns <- c(

    "/Applications/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex",

    "/Applications/IBM/ILOG/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex",

    "/opt/ibm/ILOG/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex",

    "/opt/IBM/ILOG/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex",

    path.expand(
      "~/Applications/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex"
    ),

    path.expand(
      "~/Applications/IBM/ILOG/CPLEX_Studio*/cplex/bin/*/cplex"
    )
  )


  for (
    pattern in mac_patterns
  ) {

    candidates <- c(
      candidates,
      Sys.glob(pattern)
    )
  }


  candidates <- unique(
    candidates[
      nzchar(candidates)
    ]
  )


  candidates <- candidates[
    file.exists(candidates)
  ]


  if (
    length(candidates) > 0
  ) {

    executable_candidates <- candidates[
      file.access(
        candidates,
        mode = 1
      ) == 0
    ]


    if (
      length(executable_candidates) > 0
    ) {

      return(
        normalizePath(
          executable_candidates[1],
          mustWork = TRUE
        )
      )
    }


    return(
      normalizePath(
        candidates[1],
        mustWork = TRUE
      )
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Spotlight fallback on macOS
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    identical(
      Sys.info()[["sysname"]],
      "Darwin"
    ) &&
    file.exists(
      "/usr/bin/mdfind"
    )
  ) {

    spotlight_results <- tryCatch(

      system2(
        "/usr/bin/mdfind",
        args = shQuote(
          "kMDItemFSName == 'cplex'"
        ),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = FALSE
      ),

      error = function(e) {
        character(0)
      }
    )


    spotlight_results <- spotlight_results[
      basename(
        spotlight_results
      ) == "cplex"
    ]


    spotlight_results <- spotlight_results[
      grepl(
        "/cplex/bin/",
        spotlight_results,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
    ]


    spotlight_results <- spotlight_results[
      file.exists(
        spotlight_results
      )
    ]


    if (
      length(spotlight_results) > 0
    ) {

      return(
        normalizePath(
          spotlight_results[1],
          mustWork = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  }


  return(
    NA_character_
  )
}


cplex_exe <- find_cplex_executable()


if (
  is.na(cplex_exe)
) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "CPLEX executable was not automatically located. ",
      "CPLEX fits will be recorded as unavailable until ",
      "cplex_exe is set to the installed executable."
    )
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "CPLEX found at:\n",
    cplex_exe,
    "\n\n"
  )
}


## ============================================================
## Exact fixed-cardinality CPLEX problem
## ============================================================

best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 10,
    cplex_exe = cplex_exe
) {

  if (
    is.na(cplex_exe) ||
    !nzchar(cplex_exe)
  ) {

    stop(
      "CPLEX executable is unavailable."
    )
  }


  n <- nrow(X)

  p <- ncol(X)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Temporary files
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )

  dir.create(work)


  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )

  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )


  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Objective
  ##
  ## min sum r_i^2
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )

  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )


  for (
    i in seq_len(n)
  ) {

    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }


  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Residual constraints
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )


  chunk <- 10


  for (
    i in seq_len(n)
  ) {

    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )


    for (
      cc in seq_along(starts)
    ) {

      start <- starts[cc]

      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )


      txt <- ""


      if (
        cc == 1
      ) {

        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }


      for (
        j in start:finish
      ) {

        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]


        if (
          abs(a) < 1e-14
        ) {

          next
        }


        if (
          a >= 0
        ) {

          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )

        } else {

          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }


      if (
        finish == p
      ) {

        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }


      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Big-M constraints
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (
    j in seq_len(p)
  ) {

    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )


    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Exactly s selected
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )


  chunk_z <- 25


  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {

    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )


    txt <- ""


    for (
      j in start:finish
    ) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }


    if (
      finish == p
    ) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }


    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Bounds
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )


  for (
    j in seq_len(p)
  ) {

    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }


  for (
    i in seq_len(n)
  ) {

    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Binary variables
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )


  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {

    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )


    txt <- ""


    for (
      j in start:finish
    ) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }


    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }


  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )

  close(con)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Run CPLEX
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  oldwd <- getwd()

  on.exit(
    setwd(oldwd),
    add = TRUE
  )


  setwd(work)


  out <- system2(

    command = cplex_exe,

    args = c(
      "-c",
      shQuote(
        "read model.lp"
      ),
      shQuote(
        "optimize"
      ),
      shQuote(
        "write solution.sol"
      ),
      shQuote(
        "quit"
      )
    ),

    stdout = TRUE,

    stderr = TRUE
  )


  setwd(oldwd)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Check solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !file.exists(solfile)
  ) {

    cat(
      paste(
        out,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n"
    )

    stop(
      "CPLEX did not produce solution.sol."
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Read solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )


  beta <- numeric(p)

  z <- numeric(p)


  for (
    line in sol
  ) {

    if (
      !grepl(
        "<variable",
        line,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
    ) {

      next
    }


    a <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]


    if (
      length(a) != 2
    ) {

      next
    }


    name <- a[2]


    a <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]


    if (
      length(a) != 2
    ) {

      next
    }


    value <- as.numeric(
      a[2]
    )


    if (
      grepl(
        "^beta_[0-9]+$",
        name
      )
    ) {

      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )


      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {

        beta[j] <- value
      }
    }


    if (
      grepl(
        "^z_[0-9]+$",
        name
      )
    ) {

      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )


      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {

        z[j] <- value
      }
    }
  }


  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
      as.vector(
        X %*% beta
      )
    )^2
  )


  return(
    list(

      selected =
        which(
          z > 0.5
        ),

      beta =
        beta,

      z =
        z,

      rss =
        rss,

      cplex_output =
        out
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 4: Generate one Monte Carlo replication

```{r exp5-generate-base}
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p,
    rho,
    max_s,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    master_seed
) {

  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )


  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n * p
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )


  X_raw <-
    sqrt(rho) *
      matrix(
        common_factor,
        nrow = n,
        ncol = p
      ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
      Z


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Centre and standardise predictors
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  X <- scale(
    X_raw,
    center = TRUE,
    scale = TRUE
  )


  X <- as.matrix(
    X
  )


  colnames(X) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(p)
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Nested true support
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  active_order <- sample(
    seq_len(p),
    size = max_s,
    replace = FALSE
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Coefficients
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  magnitudes <- runif(
    max_s,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )


  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = max_s,
    replace = TRUE
  )


  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common noise direction
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )


  epsilon_base <- as.numeric(
    scale(
      epsilon_base,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      X =
        X,

      active_order =
        active_order,

      beta_values =
        beta_values,

      epsilon_base =
        epsilon_base
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 5: Construct dataset at a particular true model size

```{r exp5-make-dataset}
make_dataset <- function(
    base,
    s,
    target_snr
) {

  X <- base$X

  p <- ncol(X)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True support
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  true_support <- sort(
    base$active_order[
      seq_len(s)
    ]
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True beta
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  beta_true <- numeric(
    p
  )


  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <-
    base$beta_values[
      seq_len(s)
    ]


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Signal
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  signal <- as.vector(
    X %*%
      beta_true
  )


  signal_variance <- var(
    signal
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Maintain fixed SNR
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  sigma <- sqrt(
    signal_variance /
      target_snr
  )


  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    base$epsilon_base


  y <-
    signal +
    epsilon


  y <- y -
    mean(y)


  realised_snr <-
    var(signal) /
    var(epsilon)


  return(
    list(

      X =
        X,

      y =
        y,

      beta_true =
        beta_true,

      true_support =
        true_support,

      sigma =
        sigma,

      realised_snr =
        realised_snr
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 6: Common OLS refit

```{r exp5-ols-refit}
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {

  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )


  p <- ncol(X)


  if (
    length(support) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      list(

        beta =
          numeric(p),

        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(y)
          ),

        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }


  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )


  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )


  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients


  return(
    list(

      beta =
        beta,

      fitted =
        as.vector(
          fit$fitted.values
        ),

      rss =
        sum(
          fit$residuals^2
        )
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 7: Support recovery metrics

```{r exp5-support-metrics}
support_metrics <- function(
    selected,
    truth
) {

  selected <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        selected
      )
    )
  )


  truth <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        truth
      )
    )
  )


  TP <- length(
    intersect(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  FP <- length(
    setdiff(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  FN <- length(
    setdiff(
      truth,
      selected
    )
  )


  union_size <- length(
    union(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  jaccard <-

    if (
      union_size > 0
    ) {

      TP /
        union_size

    } else {

      1
    }


  precision <-

    if (
      length(selected) > 0
    ) {

      TP /
        length(selected)

    } else {

      NA_real_
    }


  recall <-

    if (
      length(truth) > 0
    ) {

      TP /
        length(truth)

    } else {

      NA_real_
    }


  return(
    list(

      exact =
        setequal(
          selected,
          truth
        ),

      TP =
        TP,

      FP =
        FP,

      FN =
        FN,

      precision =
        precision,

      recall =
        recall,

      jaccard =
        jaccard
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 8: Safe fitting wrapper

```{r exp5-safe-fit}
safe_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    ...
) {

  tryCatch(

    {

      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )


      ans$success <- TRUE

      ans$error <- NA_character_


      return(
        ans
      )
    },

    error = function(e) {

      return(
        list(

          success =
            FALSE,

          support =
            integer(0),

          runtime =
            NA_real_,

          exact_size_available =
            FALSE,

          error =
            conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

## Section 9: CPLEX fixed-size wrapper

```{r exp5-cplex-wrapper}
fit_cplex_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k,
    M
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  fit <- best_subset_cplex(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    s = k,
    M = M,
    cplex_exe =
      cplex_exe
  )


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time


  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$selected
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        length(
          support
        ) ==
        k
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 10: COMBSS fixed-size wrapper

```{r exp5-combss-wrapper}
fit_combss_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  fit <- combss::combss(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    q = k,
    lam_ridge = 0,
    Niter = 25,
    alpha = 0.01,
    scale = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time


  if (
    length(
      fit$subset_list
    ) < k
  ) {

    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        k
      )
    )
  }


  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[
        k
      ]]
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        length(
          support
        ) ==
        k
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 11: Fit fixed-size CPLEX or COMBSS path

```{r exp5-fixed-size-path}
fit_fixed_size_path <- function(
    method,
    X,
    y,
    truth,
    k_values,
    big_M
) {

  path <- vector(
    "list",
    length(
      k_values
    )
  )


  names(
    path
  ) <- as.character(
    k_values
  )


  for (
    k in k_values
  ) {

    cat(
      method,
      "k =",
      k,
      "\n"
    )


    if (
      method == "CPLEX"
    ) {

      fit <- safe_fit(
        fit_cplex_method,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k,
        M = big_M
      )

    } else if (
      method == "COMBSS"
    ) {

      fit <- safe_fit(
        fit_combss_method,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k
      )

    } else {

      stop(
        "Method must be CPLEX or COMBSS."
      )
    }


    if (
      !fit$success ||
      !fit$exact_size_available
    ) {

      path[[
        as.character(k)
      ]] <- list(

        k =
          k,

        available =
          FALSE,

        support =
          integer(0),

        fitted =
          NULL,

        rss =
          NA_real_,

        runtime =
          fit$runtime,

        exact =
          NA,

        jaccard =
          NA_real_
      )


      next
    }


    refit <- ols_refit(
      X = X,
      y = y,
      support =
        fit$support
    )


    metrics <- support_metrics(
      selected =
        fit$support,
      truth =
        truth
    )


    path[[
      as.character(k)
    ]] <- list(

      k =
        k,

      available =
        TRUE,

      support =
        fit$support,

      fitted =
        refit$fitted,

      rss =
        refit$rss,

      runtime =
        fit$runtime,

      exact =
        metrics$exact,

      jaccard =
        metrics$jaccard
    )
  }


  return(
    path
  )
}
```

## Section 12: ABESS single solution path

```{r exp5-abess-path}
## ============================================================
## IMPORTANT
##
## ABESS is fitted ONCE per dataset over all candidate model
## sizes.
##
## The individual size-k solutions are then extracted from
## that single fit.
##
## The native GIC-selected model is also obtained from this
## SAME fitted ABESS object.
## ============================================================

fit_abess_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    truth,
    k_values
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## ONE ABESS FIT
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = k_values,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Extract each support size from the SAME fit
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  path <- vector(
    "list",
    length(
      k_values
    )
  )


  names(
    path
  ) <- as.character(
    k_values
  )


  for (
    k in k_values
  ) {

    model_k <- abess::extract(
      fit,
      support.size = k
    )


    beta_k <- as.numeric(
      model_k$beta
    )


    support_k <- sort(
      which(
        abs(
          beta_k
        ) >
        1e-10
      )
    )


    if (
      length(
        support_k
      ) != k
    ) {

      path[[
        as.character(k)
      ]] <- list(

        k =
          k,

        available =
          FALSE,

        support =
          integer(0),

        fitted =
          NULL,

        rss =
          NA_real_,

        runtime =
          runtime,

        exact =
          NA,

        jaccard =
          NA_real_
      )


      next
    }


    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Common OLS refit
    ## --------------------------------------------------------

    refit <- ols_refit(
      X = X,
      y = y,
      support =
        support_k
    )


    metrics <- support_metrics(
      selected =
        support_k,
      truth =
        truth
    )


    path[[
      as.character(k)
    ]] <- list(

      k =
        k,

      available =
        TRUE,

      support =
        support_k,

      fitted =
        refit$fitted,

      rss =
        refit$rss,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact =
        metrics$exact,

      jaccard =
        metrics$jaccard
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Native ABESS GIC size
  ##
  ## Taken from the SAME fit.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  gic_size <- as.integer(
    fit$best.size
  )


  gic_support <- integer(
    0
  )


  if (
    length(gic_size) == 1 &&
    !is.na(gic_size) &&
    gic_size %in% k_values
  ) {

    gic_model <- abess::extract(
      fit,
      support.size =
        gic_size
    )


    gic_beta <- as.numeric(
      gic_model$beta
    )


    gic_support <- sort(
      which(
        abs(
          gic_beta
        ) >
        1e-10
      )
    )
  }


  return(
    list(

      fit =
        fit,

      path =
        path,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      gic_size =
        gic_size,

      gic_support =
        gic_support
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 13: L0Learn solution path

```{r exp5-l0learn-path}
fit_l0learn_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k_values,
    max_support,
    grid_points,
    upper_multiplier,
    lower_multiplier,
    refine_points,
    refine_rounds
) {

  total_start <- proc.time()[3]


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Pilot path
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize = max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    intercept = FALSE
  )


  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )


  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
      pilot_lambda >
      0
  ]


  if (
    length(
      pilot_lambda
    ) < 2
  ) {

    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }


  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    upper_multiplier


  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    lower_multiplier


  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from =
        log(
          lambda_upper
        ),
      to =
        log(
          lambda_lower
        ),
      length.out =
        grid_points
    )
  )


  fit_grid <- function(
      grid
  ) {

    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize =
        max_support,
      lambdaGrid =
        list(
          grid
        ),
      partialSort = TRUE,
      maxIters = 200,
      rtol = 1e-6,
      atol = 1e-9,
      activeSet = TRUE,
      activeSetNum = 3,
      maxSwaps = 100,
      screenSize =
        ncol(X),
      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }


  fit <- fit_grid(
    lambda_grid
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Refine around skipped sizes
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (
    refinement_round in
      seq_len(
        refine_rounds
      )
  ) {

    support_sizes <- as.integer(
      fit$suppSize[[1]]
    )


    fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
      fit$lambda[[1]]
    )


    missing_sizes <- setdiff(
      k_values,
      unique(
        support_sizes
      )
    )


    if (
      length(
        missing_sizes
      ) == 0
    ) {

      break
    }


    extra_lambda <- numeric(
      0
    )


    for (
      target_k in
        missing_sizes
    ) {

      if (
        length(
          support_sizes
        ) < 2
      ) {

        next
      }


      for (
        i in seq_len(
          length(
            support_sizes
          ) - 1
        )
      ) {

        s1 <-
          support_sizes[i]

        s2 <-
          support_sizes[
            i + 1
          ]


        if (
          min(
            s1,
            s2
          ) <
            target_k &&
          max(
            s1,
            s2
          ) >
            target_k
        ) {

          lambda_a <-
            fitted_lambda[i]

          lambda_b <-
            fitted_lambda[
              i + 1
            ]


          upper <- max(
            lambda_a,
            lambda_b
          )


          lower <- min(
            lambda_a,
            lambda_b
          )


          if (
            is.finite(
              upper
            ) &&
            is.finite(
              lower
            ) &&
            lower > 0 &&
            upper > lower
          ) {

            local_grid <- exp(
              seq(
                from =
                  log(
                    upper
                  ),
                to =
                  log(
                    lower
                  ),
                length.out =
                  refine_points +
                  2
              )
            )


            local_grid <-
              local_grid[
                -c(
                  1,
                  length(
                    local_grid
                  )
                )
              ]


            extra_lambda <- c(
              extra_lambda,
              local_grid
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }


    if (
      length(
        extra_lambda
      ) == 0
    ) {

      break
    }


    lambda_grid <- sort(
      unique(
        c(
          lambda_grid,
          extra_lambda
        )
      ),
      decreasing = TRUE
    )


    fit <- fit_grid(
      lambda_grid
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Final path
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )


  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )


  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )


  if (
    nrow(
      beta_path
    ) != ncol(X) &&
    ncol(
      beta_path
    ) == ncol(X)
  ) {

    beta_path <- t(
      beta_path
    )
  }


  supports <- vector(
    "list",
    length(
      k_values
    )
  )


  names(
    supports
  ) <- as.character(
    k_values
  )


  selected_lambda <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      k_values
    )
  )


  names(
    selected_lambda
  ) <- as.character(
    k_values
  )


  for (
    target_k in
      k_values
  ) {

    idx <- which(
      support_sizes ==
        target_k
    )


    if (
      length(idx) == 0
    ) {

      supports[[
        as.character(
          target_k
        )
      ]] <- integer(0)

      next
    }


    candidate_supports <- vector(
      "list",
      length(idx)
    )


    candidate_rss <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(idx)
    )


    for (
      jj in seq_along(
        idx
      )
    ) {

      path_index <-
        idx[jj]


      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        path_index
      ]


      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
            1e-10
        )
      )


      candidate_supports[[
        jj
      ]] <-
        support_j


      candidate_rss[jj] <-
        ols_refit(
          X = X,
          y = y,
          support =
            support_j
        )$rss
    }


    best_j <- which.min(
      candidate_rss
    )


    best_index <- idx[
      best_j
    ]


    supports[[
      as.character(
        target_k
      )
    ]] <-
      candidate_supports[[
        best_j
      ]]


    selected_lambda[
      as.character(
        target_k
      )
    ] <-
      fitted_lambda[
        best_index
      ]
  }


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start


  return(
    list(

      supports =
        supports,

      selected_lambda =
        selected_lambda,

      available_sizes =
        sort(
          intersect(
            unique(
              support_sizes
            ),
            k_values
          )
        ),

      runtime =
        runtime
    )
  )
}
```

```{r exp5-l0-common-path}
build_l0_path <- function(

        support =

        fitted =

        exact =

        jaccard =

}
```

## Section 15: Score-to-level and piecewise diagnostic

```{r exp5-diagnostic}
compute_model_size_diagnostic <- function(
    path,
    n,
    p,
    k_values,
    k_max,
    min_left_points,
    min_right_points,
    ratio_floor
) {

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Reference model
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  ref <- path[[
    as.character(
      k_max
    )
  ]]


  if (
    is.null(ref) ||
    !isTRUE(
      ref$available
    )
  ) {

    return(
      list(

        valid =
          FALSE,

        curve =
          NULL,

        threshold_hat =
          NA_integer_,

        breakpoint_after_k =
          NA_integer_,

        piecewise_hat =
          NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Noise variance estimate
  ##
  ## Same definition as working diagnostic.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  sigma_hat_sq <-
    ref$rss /
    (
      n -
        k_max
    )


  curve_rows <- vector(
    "list",
    length(
      k_values
    )
  )


  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      k_values
    )
  ) {

    k <-
      k_values[ii]


    fit_k <- path[[
      as.character(k)
    ]]


    if (
      is.null(fit_k) ||
      !isTRUE(
        fit_k$available
      )
    ) {

      curve_rows[[
        ii
      ]] <- data.frame(

        k =
          k,

        score =
          NA_real_,

        level =
          NA_real_,

        ratio =
          NA_real_,

        available =
          FALSE
      )


      next
    }


    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Score
    ##
    ## Raw SUM of squared fitted-value differences.
    ## --------------------------------------------------------

    score_k <- sum(
      (
        fit_k$fitted -
          ref$fitted
      )^2
    )


    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Level
    ## --------------------------------------------------------

    level_k <-
      4 *
      (
        sqrt(k) +
          sqrt(k_max)
      )^2 *
      (
        2 *
          log(p) +
          log(n) +
          1
      ) *
      sigma_hat_sq


    ratio_k <-
      score_k /
      level_k


    curve_rows[[
      ii
    ]] <- data.frame(

      k =
        k,

      score =
        score_k,

      level =
        level_k,

      ratio =
        ratio_k,

      available =
        TRUE
    )
  }


  curve <- bind_rows(
    curve_rows
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Threshold estimate
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  threshold_candidates <-
    curve |>
    filter(
      available,
      is.finite(
        ratio
      ),
      ratio <= 1
    )


  threshold_hat <-

    if (
      nrow(
        threshold_candidates
      ) > 0
    ) {

      min(
        threshold_candidates$k
      )

    } else {

      NA_integer_
    }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Piecewise change-point
  ##
  ## k_max excluded because Score(k_max) = 0.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  piecewise_df <-
    curve |>
    filter(
      k < k_max,
      available,
      is.finite(
        ratio
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      log_ratio =
        log10(
          pmax(
            ratio,
            ratio_floor
          )
        )
    )


  expected_k <-
    k_values[
      k_values < k_max
    ]


  if (
    !identical(
      as.integer(
        piecewise_df$k
      ),
      as.integer(
        expected_k
      )
    )
  ) {

    return(
      list(

        valid =
          TRUE,

        curve =
          curve,

        threshold_hat =
          threshold_hat,

        breakpoint_after_k =
          NA_integer_,

        piecewise_hat =
          NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }


  n_piece <- nrow(
    piecewise_df
  )


  candidate_indices <- seq(
    from =
      min_left_points,
    to =
      n_piece -
      min_right_points
  )


  if (
    length(
      candidate_indices
    ) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      list(

        valid =
          TRUE,

        curve =
          curve,

        threshold_hat =
          threshold_hat,

        breakpoint_after_k =
          NA_integer_,

        piecewise_hat =
          NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }


  candidate_breaks <-
    piecewise_df$k[
      candidate_indices
    ]


  candidate_sse <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      candidate_breaks
    )
  )


  for (
    jj in seq_along(
      candidate_breaks
    )
  ) {

    b <- candidate_breaks[
      jj
    ]


    left <-
      piecewise_df |>
      filter(
        k <= b
      )


    right <-
      piecewise_df |>
      filter(
        k > b
      )


    fit_left <- lm(
      log_ratio ~ k,
      data =
        left
    )


    fit_right <- lm(
      log_ratio ~ k,
      data =
        right
    )


    candidate_sse[
      jj
    ] <-
      sum(
        residuals(
          fit_left
        )^2
      ) +
      sum(
        residuals(
          fit_right
        )^2
      )
  }


  best_index <- which.min(
    candidate_sse
  )


  breakpoint_after_k <-
    candidate_breaks[
      best_index
    ]


  piecewise_hat <-
    breakpoint_after_k +
    1L


  return(
    list(

      valid =
        TRUE,

      curve =
        curve,

      threshold_hat =
        threshold_hat,

      breakpoint_after_k =
        breakpoint_after_k,

      piecewise_hat =
        piecewise_hat
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 16: Metrics at estimated model size

```{r exp5-estimated-metrics}
estimated_model_metrics <- function(
    path,
    estimated_size,
    truth
) {

  if (
    is.na(
      estimated_size
    )
  ) {

    return(
      list(
        exact = NA,
        jaccard = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  fit <- path[[
    as.character(
      estimated_size
    )
  ]]


  if (
    is.null(fit) ||
    !isTRUE(
      fit$available
    )
  ) {

    return(
      list(
        exact = NA,
        jaccard = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  return(
    support_metrics(
      selected =
        fit$support,
      truth =
        truth
    )
  )
}
```

## Section 18: Run Experiment 5

```{r exp5-main-loop}
experiment_start <- Sys.time()


for (
  rep_id in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    rep_id,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )

  cat("============================================================\n")


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common replication base
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id =
      rep_id,
    n =
      n,
    p =
      p,
    rho =
      rho,
    max_s =
      max(
        true_sizes
      ),
    beta_min =
      beta_min,
    beta_max =
      beta_max,
    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )


  for (
    true_s in
      true_sizes
  ) {

    cat("\n")

    cat(
      "True model size =",
      true_s,
      "\n"
    )

    cat(
      "------------------------------\n"
    )


    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Construct dataset
    ## --------------------------------------------------------

    data <- make_dataset(
      base =
        base,
      s =
        true_s,
      target_snr =
        target_snr
    )


    cat(
      "Realised SNR =",
      round(
        data$realised_snr,
        4
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    ## ========================================================
    ## CPLEX
    ## ========================================================

    cat(
      "\nCPLEX path\n"
    )


    cplex_path <- fit_fixed_size_path(
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      truth =
        data$true_support,
      k_values =
        k_values,
      big_M =
        big_M
    )


    ## ========================================================
    ## COMBSS
    ## ========================================================

    cat(
      "\nCOMBSS path\n"
    )


    combss_path <- fit_fixed_size_path(
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      truth =
        data$true_support,
      k_values =
        k_values,
      big_M =
        big_M
    )


    ## ========================================================
    ## ABESS
    ##
    ## ONE FIT over all candidate sizes
    ## ========================================================

    cat(
      "\nABESS single path fit\n"
    )


    abess_fit <- tryCatch(

      fit_abess_path(
        X =
          data$X,
        y =
          data$y,
        truth =
          data$true_support,
        k_values =
          k_values
      ),

      error = function(e) {

        cat(
          "ABESS path failed:",
          conditionMessage(e),
          "\n"
        )

        NULL
      }
    )


    if (
      !is.null(
        abess_fit
      )
    ) {

      abess_path <-
        abess_fit$path

    } else {

      abess_path <- vector(
        "list",
        length(
          k_values
        )
      )


      names(
        abess_path
      ) <- as.character(
        k_values
      )


      for (
        k in k_values
      ) {

        abess_path[[
          as.character(k)
        ]] <- list(

          k =
            k,

          available =
            FALSE,

          support =
            integer(0),

          fitted =
            NULL,

          rss =
            NA_real_,

          runtime =
            NA_real_,

          exact =
            NA,

          jaccard =
            NA_real_
        )
      }
    }


    ## ========================================================
    ## ABESS GIC
    ##
    ## SAME ABESS FIT
    ## ========================================================

    if (
      !is.null(
        abess_fit
      ) &&
      length(
        abess_fit$gic_support
      ) > 0
    ) {

      gic_size <-
        abess_fit$gic_size


      gic_metrics <- support_metrics(
        selected =
          abess_fit$gic_support,
        truth =
          data$true_support
      )


      gic_exact <-
        gic_metrics$exact


      gic_jaccard <-
        gic_metrics$jaccard

    } else {

      gic_size <-
        NA_integer_


      gic_exact <-
        NA


      gic_jaccard <-
        NA_real_
    }


    abess_gic_list[[
      row_gic
    ]] <- data.frame(

      rep =
        rep_id,

      true_s =
        true_s,

      gic_size =
        gic_size,

      size_correct =
        !is.na(
          gic_size
        ) &&
        gic_size ==
          true_s,

      absolute_error =

        if (
          is.na(
            gic_size
          )
        ) {

          NA_real_

        } else {

          abs(
            gic_size -
              true_s
          )
        },

      exact_model_recovery =
        gic_exact,

      jaccard =
        gic_jaccard
    )


    row_gic <-
      row_gic +
      1


    ## ========================================================
    ## L0Learn
    ## ========================================================

    cat(
      "\nL0Learn path\n"
    )


    l0_fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_l0learn_path,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      k_values =
        k_values,
      max_support =
        l0_max_support,
      grid_points =
        l0_grid_points,
      upper_multiplier =
        l0_upper_multiplier,
      lower_multiplier =
        l0_lower_multiplier,
      refine_points =
        l0_refine_points,
      refine_rounds =
        l0_refine_rounds
    )


    if (
      l0_fit$success
    ) {

      l0_path <- build_l0_path(
        l0_fit =
          l0_fit,
        X =
          data$X,
        y =
          data$y,
        truth =
          data$true_support,
        k_values =
          k_values
      )


      l0_available <-
        l0_fit$available_sizes

    } else {

      l0_path <- vector(
        "list",
        length(
          k_values
        )
      )


      names(
        l0_path
      ) <- as.character(
        k_values
      )


      for (
        k in k_values
      ) {

        l0_path[[
          as.character(k)
        ]] <- list(

          k =
            k,

          available =
            FALSE,

          support =
            integer(0),

          fitted =
            NULL,

          rss =
            NA_real_,

          runtime =
            NA_real_,

          exact =
            NA,

          jaccard =
            NA_real_
        )
      }


      l0_available <-
        integer(0)
    }


    l0_availability_list[[
      row_l0
    ]] <- data.frame(

      rep =
        rep_id,

      true_s =
        true_s,

      number_available =
        length(
          l0_available
        ),

      complete_path =
        all(
          k_values %in%
            l0_available
        ),

      available_sizes =
        paste(
          l0_available,
          collapse = ","
        ),

      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )


    row_l0 <-
      row_l0 +
      1


    ## ========================================================
    ## Collect paths
    ## ========================================================

    method_paths <- list(

      CPLEX =
        cplex_path,

      COMBSS =
        combss_path,

      L0Learn =
        l0_path,

      ABESS =
        abess_path
    )


    ## ========================================================
    ## Model-size diagnostics
    ## ========================================================

    for (
      method in names(
        method_paths
      )
    ) {

      path <-
        method_paths[[
          method
        ]]


      diag <- compute_model_size_diagnostic(
        path =
          path,
        n =
          n,
        p =
          p,
        k_values =
          k_values,
        k_max =
          k_max,
        min_left_points =
          min_left_points,
        min_right_points =
          min_right_points,
        ratio_floor =
          ratio_floor
      )


      threshold_metrics <-
        estimated_model_metrics(
          path =
            path,
          estimated_size =
            diag$threshold_hat,
          truth =
            data$true_support
        )


      piecewise_metrics <-
        estimated_model_metrics(
          path =
            path,
          estimated_size =
            diag$piecewise_hat,
          truth =
            data$true_support
        )


      diagnostic_summary_list[[
        row_diag
      ]] <- data.frame(

        rep =
          rep_id,

        true_s =
          true_s,

        method =
          method,

        threshold_hat =
          diag$threshold_hat,

        threshold_correct =
          !is.na(
            diag$threshold_hat
          ) &&
          diag$threshold_hat ==
            true_s,

        threshold_abs_error =

          if (
            is.na(
              diag$threshold_hat
            )
          ) {

            NA_real_

          } else {

            abs(
              diag$threshold_hat -
                true_s
            )
          },

        threshold_model_exact =
          threshold_metrics$exact,

        threshold_jaccard =
          threshold_metrics$jaccard,

        breakpoint_after_k =
          diag$breakpoint_after_k,

        piecewise_hat =
          diag$piecewise_hat,

        piecewise_correct =
          !is.na(
            diag$piecewise_hat
          ) &&
          diag$piecewise_hat ==
            true_s,

        piecewise_abs_error =

          if (
            is.na(
              diag$piecewise_hat
            )
          ) {

            NA_real_

          } else {

            abs(
              diag$piecewise_hat -
                true_s
            )
          },

        piecewise_model_exact =
          piecewise_metrics$exact,

        piecewise_jaccard =
          piecewise_metrics$jaccard,

        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )


      row_diag <-
        row_diag +
        1


      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Store score/level curve
      ## ------------------------------------------------------

      if (
        !is.null(
          diag$curve
        )
      ) {

        curve_temp <-
          diag$curve |>
          mutate(

            rep =
              rep_id,

            true_s =
              true_s,

            method =
              method,

            threshold_hat =
              diag$threshold_hat,

            breakpoint_after_k =
              diag$breakpoint_after_k,

            piecewise_hat =
              diag$piecewise_hat
          )


        curve_list[[
          row_curve
        ]] <-
          curve_temp


        row_curve <-
          row_curve +
          1
      }


      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Store each candidate model
      ## ------------------------------------------------------

      for (
        k in k_values
      ) {

        fit_k <- path[[
          as.character(k)
        ]]


        fixed_path_result_list[[
          row_path
        ]] <- data.frame(

          rep =
            rep_id,

          true_s =
            true_s,

          method =
            method,

          k =
            k,

          available =
            isTRUE(
              fit_k$available
            ),

          rss =
            fit_k$rss,

          runtime =
            fit_k$runtime,

          exact_recovery =
            fit_k$exact,

          jaccard =
            fit_k$jaccard,

          support_key =

            if (
              isTRUE(
                fit_k$available
              )
            ) {

              paste(
                fit_k$support,
                collapse = ","
              )

            } else {

              NA_character_
            },

          stringsAsFactors =
            FALSE
        )


        row_path <-
          row_path +
          1
      }
    }
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Checkpoint
  ## ==========================================================

  checkpoint <- list(

    completed_rep =
      rep_id,

    diagnostic_summary =
      bind_rows(
        diagnostic_summary_list
      ),

    curves =
      bind_rows(
        curve_list
      ),

    fixed_path_results =
      bind_rows(
        fixed_path_result_list
      ),

    abess_gic =
      bind_rows(
        abess_gic_list
      ),

    l0_availability =
      bind_rows(
        l0_availability_list
      )
  )


  saveRDS(
    checkpoint,
    checkpoint_file
  )


  cat(
    "\nCheckpoint saved after replication",
    rep_id,
    "\n"
  )
}
```

## Section 21: Optimisation accuracy relative to CPLEX

```{r exp5-cplex-comparison}
cplex_reference <-
  fixed_path_results |>
  filter(
    method ==
      "CPLEX",
    available
  ) |>
  select(

    rep,

    true_s,

    k,

    cplex_rss =
      rss,

    cplex_support =
      support_key
  )


optimisation_comparison <-
  fixed_path_results |>
  filter(
    method !=
      "CPLEX",
    available
  ) |>
  left_join(
    cplex_reference,
    by = c(
      "rep",
      "true_s",
      "k"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(

    relative_rss_gap =
      (
        rss -
          cplex_rss
      ) /
      cplex_rss,

    support_agreement =
      support_key ==
        cplex_support
  )
```

## Section 28: Select representative ABESS diagnostic

```{r exp5-example-select}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Explicit example
## ------------------------------------------------------------

example_true_s <- 4

example_rep <- 1


example_curve <-
  curve_results |>
  filter(
    method ==
      "ABESS",
    true_s ==
      example_true_s,
    rep ==
      example_rep
  ) |>
  arrange(
    k
  )


if (
  nrow(
    example_curve
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "Requested ABESS example was not found."
  )
}


example_threshold <-
  unique(
    example_curve$threshold_hat
  )


example_breakpoint <-
  unique(
    example_curve$breakpoint_after_k
  )


example_piecewise <-
  unique(
    example_curve$piecewise_hat
  )


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Remove reference model from plot
##
## Score(k_max) = 0 by construction.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

example_plot_data <-
  example_curve |>
  filter(
    k < k_max,
    available,
    is.finite(
      ratio
    ),
    ratio > 0
  )
```

## Section 29: Fit piecewise lines for representative ABESS diagnostic

```{r exp5-example-piecewise}
piecewise_plot_data <-
  example_plot_data |>
  mutate(
    log_ratio =
      log10(
        pmax(
          ratio,
          ratio_floor
        )
      )
  )


if (
  length(
    example_breakpoint
  ) == 1 &&
  !is.na(
    example_breakpoint
  )
) {

  example_left <-
    piecewise_plot_data |>
    filter(
      k <=
        example_breakpoint
    )


  example_right <-
    piecewise_plot_data |>
    filter(
      k >
        example_breakpoint
    )


  example_left_fit <- lm(
    log_ratio ~ k,
    data =
      example_left
  )


  example_right_fit <- lm(
    log_ratio ~ k,
    data =
      example_right
  )


  example_left$piecewise_log_fit <-
    predict(
      example_left_fit,
      newdata =
        example_left
    )


  example_right$piecewise_log_fit <-
    predict(
      example_right_fit,
      newdata =
        example_right
    )


  example_fitted <-
    bind_rows(
      example_left,
      example_right
    ) |>
    mutate(
      piecewise_fit =
        10^piecewise_log_fit
    )

} else {

  example_fitted <-
    piecewise_plot_data |>
    mutate(
      piecewise_fit =
        NA_real_
    )
}
```

## Section 30: Plot ABESS diagnostic in original Score/Level form

```{r exp5-example-plot}
## ============================================================
## This plot deliberately uses:
##
##   y = Score / Level
##
## on a LOGARITHMIC axis.
##
## This is the same visual form as the earlier diagnostic,
## rather than plotting log10(Score / Level) directly.
## ============================================================

plot_floor <-
  min(
    example_plot_data$ratio[
      example_plot_data$ratio > 0
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) /
  2


p_abess_diagnostic <-
  ggplot(
    example_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = k,
      y = ratio
    )
  ) +

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Vertical stems
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      xend = k,
      y = plot_floor,
      yend = ratio
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Piecewise fitted trajectory
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_line(
    data =
      example_fitted,
    aes(
      x =
        k,
      y =
        piecewise_fit,
      group =
        k <=
        example_breakpoint
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Threshold R(k) = 1
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True model size
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    xintercept =
      example_true_s,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Piecewise-estimated model size
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    xintercept =
      example_piecewise,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_y_log10() +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      1:(
        k_max -
          1
      )
  ) +

  labs(

    x =
      "Candidate model size",

    y =
      "Score / level",

    title =
      "ABESS model-size diagnostic",

    subtitle =
      paste0(
        "Replication ",
        example_rep,
        " | True s = ",
        example_true_s,
        " | Threshold estimate = ",
        example_threshold,
        " | Piecewise estimate = ",
        example_piecewise
      )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(

    plot.title =

print(

)
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## ABESS THRESHOLD DIAGNOSTIC EXAMPLE
##
## Purpose:
## Construct a clean ABESS example where
##
##     R(k) = Score(k) / Level(k)
##
## is above 1 for underspecified models and drops below 1
## around the true model size.
## ============================================================


library(abess)


## ============================================================
## 1. OLS FITTED VALUES HELPER
## ============================================================

ols_fitted_values_diag <- function(
    X,
    y,
    selected
) {

  Xs <- X[
    ,
    selected,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )


  return(
    as.vector(
      fit$fitted.values
    )
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 2. SETTINGS
## ============================================================

set.seed(12345)


n_diag <- 500

p_diag <- 50

s_true_diag <- 4

k_max_diag <- 15

rho_diag <- 0.20

sigma_diag <- 1


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Fixed true support
## ------------------------------------------------------------

true_support_diag <- c(
  3,
  11,
  27,
  41
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Strong coefficients
##
## These are deliberately strong because this is intended
## to be a diagnostic example of the threshold working.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

beta_nonzero_diag <- c(
  10,
  -9,
  8,
  -7
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Full coefficient vector
## ------------------------------------------------------------

beta_true_diag <- numeric(
  p_diag
)


beta_true_diag[
  true_support_diag
] <- beta_nonzero_diag


cat(
  "True model size:",
  s_true_diag,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "True support:",
  paste(
    true_support_diag,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "True coefficients:",
  paste(
    beta_nonzero_diag,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 3. GENERATE CORRELATED DESIGN MATRIX
##
## Same common-factor construction as your ABESS experiment.
## ============================================================

Z_diag <- matrix(
  rnorm(
    n_diag * p_diag
  ),
  nrow = n_diag,
  ncol = p_diag
)


common_factor_diag <- rnorm(
  n_diag
)


common_matrix_diag <- matrix(
  common_factor_diag,
  nrow = n_diag,
  ncol = p_diag
)


X_diag <- sqrt(rho_diag) *
  common_matrix_diag +
  sqrt(1 - rho_diag) *
  Z_diag


colnames(X_diag) <- paste0(
  "X",
  seq_len(p_diag)
)


## ============================================================
## 4. GENERATE RESPONSE
## ============================================================

epsilon_diag <- rnorm(
  n_diag,
  mean = 0,
  sd = sigma_diag
)


y_diag <- as.vector(
  X_diag %*%
    beta_true_diag +
    epsilon_diag
)


## ============================================================
## 5. FIT COMPLETE ABESS PATH
## ============================================================

diag_time <- system.time({

  fit_diag <- abess::abess(
    x = X_diag,
    y = y_diag,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = 1:k_max_diag,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    early.stop = FALSE
  )

})


elapsed_diag <- as.numeric(
  diag_time["elapsed"]
)


cat(
  "ABESS path completed in",
  round(
    elapsed_diag,
    4
  ),
  "seconds.\n"
)


cat(
  "Support sizes fitted:",
  paste(
    fit_diag$support.size,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "ABESS native GIC-selected size:",
  fit_diag$best.size,
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 6. STORAGE ALONG ABESS PATH
## ============================================================

models_diag <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = k_max_diag
)


Xb_diag <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = n_diag,
  ncol = k_max_diag
)


RSS_diag <- numeric(
  k_max_diag
)


## ============================================================
## 7. EXTRACT EACH ABESS MODEL
## ============================================================

for (k in seq_len(k_max_diag)) {

  model_k <- abess::extract(
    fit_diag,
    support.size = k
  )


  beta_k <- as.numeric(
    model_k$beta
  )


  selected_k <- sort(
    which(
      abs(beta_k) > 1e-10
    )
  )


  models_diag[[k]] <- selected_k


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Check ABESS returned the requested support size
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(selected_k) != k) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "Requested k = ",
        k,
        ", but ABESS returned ",
        length(selected_k),
        " nonzero coefficients."
      )
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## OLS refit
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  Xb_diag[, k] <- ols_fitted_values_diag(
    X = X_diag,
    y = y_diag,
    selected = selected_k
  )


  RSS_diag[k] <- sum(
    (
      y_diag -
        Xb_diag[, k]
    )^2
  )


  cat(
    "k =",
    k,
    "| selected:",
    paste(
      selected_k,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 8. SCORE
##
## Score(k)
## =
## || yhat_k - yhat_kmax ||^2
## ============================================================

score_diag <- numeric(
  k_max_diag
)


for (k in seq_len(k_max_diag)) {

  score_diag[k] <- sum(
    (
      Xb_diag[, k] -
        Xb_diag[, k_max_diag]
    )^2
  ) + 1e-16
}


## ============================================================
## 9. ESTIMATE NOISE VARIANCE
##
## sigma_hat^2
## =
## RSS(kmax) / (n - kmax)
## ============================================================

sigma2_hat_diag <-
  RSS_diag[k_max_diag] /
  (n_diag - k_max_diag)


cat(
  "\nEstimated sigma^2:",
  round(
    sigma2_hat_diag,
    5
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "True sigma^2:",
  sigma_diag^2,
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 10. LEVEL
##
## Level(k)
## =
## 4 (sqrt(k) + sqrt(kmax))^2
##   (2 log(p) + log(n) + 1)
##   sigma_hat^2
## ============================================================

x_level_diag <-
  2 * log(p_diag) +
  log(n_diag) +
  1


level_diag <- 4 *
  (
    sqrt(
      seq_len(k_max_diag)
    ) +
      sqrt(k_max_diag)
  )^2 *
  x_level_diag *
  sigma2_hat_diag


## ============================================================
## 11. SCORE / LEVEL RATIO
## ============================================================

ratio_diag <-
  score_diag /
  level_diag


## ============================================================
## 12. THRESHOLD MODEL SIZE ESTIMATE
##
## First k satisfying
##
##              R(k) <= 1
##
## Exclude k_max because Score(k_max) = 0 by construction.
## ============================================================

threshold_candidates_diag <- which(
  ratio_diag[
    1:(k_max_diag - 1)
  ] <= 1
)


if (
  length(
    threshold_candidates_diag
  ) > 0
) {

  threshold_size_diag <-
    threshold_candidates_diag[1]

} else {

  threshold_size_diag <-
    NA_integer_
}


## ============================================================
## 13. SCORE / LEVEL TABLE
## ============================================================

diagnostic_table <- data.frame(

  k = 1:(k_max_diag - 1),

  score =
    score_diag[
      1:(k_max_diag - 1)
    ],

  level =
    level_diag[
      1:(k_max_diag - 1)
    ],

  ratio =
    ratio_diag[
      1:(k_max_diag - 1)
    ],

  above_one =
    ratio_diag[
      1:(k_max_diag - 1)
    ] > 1,

  below_one =
    ratio_diag[
      1:(k_max_diag - 1)
    ] <= 1
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "SCORE / LEVEL TABLE\n"
)

cat(
  "============================================================\n\n"
)


print(
  diagnostic_table,
  digits = 5,
  row.names = FALSE
)


## ============================================================
## 14. THRESHOLD RESULT
## ============================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "THRESHOLD RESULT\n"
)

cat(
  "============================================================\n\n"
)


cat(
  "True model size:",
  s_true_diag,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Threshold estimated size:",
  threshold_size_diag,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "ABESS GIC size:",
  fit_diag$best.size,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "R(1):",
  round(
    ratio_diag[1],
    5
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "R(2):",
  round(
    ratio_diag[2],
    5
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "R(3):",
  round(
    ratio_diag[3],
    5
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "R(4):",
  round(
    ratio_diag[4],
    5
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 15. CHECK SUPPORT AT TRUE MODEL SIZE
## ============================================================

support_at_true_size <-
  models_diag[[s_true_diag]]


cat(
  "True support:\n"
)


cat(
  paste(
    true_support_diag,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "ABESS support at true size k =",
  s_true_diag,
  ":\n"
)


cat(
  paste(
    support_at_true_size,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


exact_at_true_size <- setequal(
  support_at_true_size,
  true_support_diag
)


cat(
  "Exact support recovery at true size:",
  ifelse(
    exact_at_true_size,
    "YES",
    "NO"
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 16. CHECK SUPPORT AT THRESHOLD SIZE
## ============================================================

if (
  !is.na(
    threshold_size_diag
  )
) {

  threshold_support_diag <-
    models_diag[[threshold_size_diag]]


  cat(
    "Support selected by threshold method at k =",
    threshold_size_diag,
    ":\n"
  )


  cat(
    paste(
      threshold_support_diag,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  exact_threshold_model <- setequal(
    threshold_support_diag,
    true_support_diag
  )


  cat(
    "Exact threshold-selected model:",
    ifelse(
      exact_threshold_model,
      "YES",
      "NO"
    ),
    "\n\n"
  )

}


## ============================================================
## 17. FIRST k THAT CONTAINS ALL TRUE PREDICTORS
## ============================================================

contains_true_diag <- sapply(
  models_diag,
  function(selected_support) {

    all(
      true_support_diag %in%
        selected_support
    )
  }
)


if (
  any(
    contains_true_diag
  )
) {

  first_cover_diag <-
    which(
      contains_true_diag
    )[1]

} else {

  first_cover_diag <-
    NA_integer_
}


cat(
  "First k containing all true predictors:",
  first_cover_diag,
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 18. SIMPLE DIAGNOSTIC CHECK
## ============================================================

if (
  ratio_diag[1] > 1
) {

  cat(
    "GOOD: R(1) starts above 1.\n"
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "WARNING: R(1) starts below 1.\n"
  )
}


if (
  !is.na(
    threshold_size_diag
  ) &&
    threshold_size_diag ==
      s_true_diag
) {

  cat(
    "GOOD: Threshold method recovered the true model size.\n"
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "Threshold method did not recover the true model size.\n"
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 19. PLOT SCORE / LEVEL
## ============================================================

plot_sizes_diag <-
  1:(k_max_diag - 1)


plot(
  plot_sizes_diag,
  ratio_diag[
    plot_sizes_diag
  ],
  type = "h",
  log = "y",
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Candidate model size",
  ylab = "Score / level",
  main = paste0(
    "ABESS Threshold Diagnostic: True size = ",
    s_true_diag
  )
)


points(
  plot_sizes_diag,
  ratio_diag[
    plot_sizes_diag
  ],
  pch = 19
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Threshold R(k) = 1
## ------------------------------------------------------------

abline(
  h = 1,

)


## ------------------------------------------------------------

abline(

if (
```
