```{r}
## ============================================================
## ABESS THRESHOLD DIAGNOSTIC ACROSS SNR
##
## Purpose:
## Determine how the threshold estimator
##
##     R(k) = Score(k) / Level(k)
##
## changes as signal-to-noise ratio changes.
##
## Everything except the noise magnitude is held fixed:
##
##   - X
##   - true support
##   - beta
##   - noise direction
##
## This isolates the effect of SNR.
## ============================================================


library(abess)


## ============================================================
## 1. OLS FITTED VALUES HELPER
## ============================================================

ols_fitted_values_diag <- function(
    X,
    y,
    selected
) {

  Xs <- X[
    ,
    selected,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )


  return(
    as.vector(
      fit$fitted.values
    )
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 2. SETTINGS
## ============================================================

set.seed(12345)


n_diag <- 500

p_diag <- 50

s_true_diag <- 4

k_max_diag <- 15

rho_diag <- 0.20


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## True support
## ------------------------------------------------------------

true_support_diag <- c(
  3,
  11,
  27,
  41
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## True coefficients
## ------------------------------------------------------------

beta_nonzero_diag <- c(
  10,
  -9,
  8,
  -7
)


beta_true_diag <- numeric(
  p_diag
)


beta_true_diag[
  true_support_diag
] <- beta_nonzero_diag


## ============================================================
## 3. GENERATE ONE FIXED DESIGN MATRIX
## ============================================================

common_factor_diag <- rnorm(
  n_diag
)


Z_diag <- matrix(
  rnorm(
    n_diag * p_diag
  ),
  nrow = n_diag,
  ncol = p_diag
)


X_raw_diag <-
  sqrt(rho_diag) *
  matrix(
    common_factor_diag,
    nrow = n_diag,
    ncol = p_diag
  ) +
  sqrt(1 - rho_diag) *
  Z_diag


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Centre and standardise predictors
## ------------------------------------------------------------

X_diag <- scale(
  X_raw_diag,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE
)


X_diag <- as.matrix(
  X_diag
)


colnames(X_diag) <- paste0(
  "X",
  seq_len(p_diag)
)


## ============================================================
## 4. FIXED SIGNAL
## ============================================================

signal_diag <- as.vector(
  X_diag %*%
    beta_true_diag
)


signal_variance_diag <- var(
  signal_diag
)


cat(
  "Signal variance:",
  round(
    signal_variance_diag,
    4
  ),
  "\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 5. FIXED NOISE DIRECTION
##
## Its magnitude will be changed for each SNR.
## ============================================================

epsilon_base_diag <- rnorm(
  n_diag
)


epsilon_base_diag <- as.numeric(
  scale(
    epsilon_base_diag,
    center = TRUE,
    scale = TRUE
  )
)


cat(
  "Noise base variance:",
  var(
    epsilon_base_diag
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


## ============================================================
## 6. FUNCTION TO RUN ONE SNR
## ============================================================

run_abess_threshold_snr <- function(
    target_snr,
    verbose = FALSE
) {

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Scale noise to target SNR
  ##
  ## SNR = Var(signal) / Var(noise)
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  sigma_diag <- sqrt(
    signal_variance_diag /
      target_snr
  )


  epsilon_diag <-
    sigma_diag *
    epsilon_base_diag


  y_diag <-
    signal_diag +
    epsilon_diag


  ## Numerical centring
  y_diag <-
    y_diag -
    mean(
      y_diag
    )


  realised_snr_diag <-
    var(
      signal_diag
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon_diag
    )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Fit complete ABESS path
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  fit_diag <- abess::abess(
    x = X_diag,
    y = y_diag,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = 1:k_max_diag,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    early.stop = FALSE
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Storage
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  models_diag <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = k_max_diag
  )


  Xb_diag <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = n_diag,
    ncol = k_max_diag
  )


  RSS_diag <- numeric(
    k_max_diag
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Extract every support and OLS refit
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (
    k in
      seq_len(
        k_max_diag
      )
  ) {

    model_k <- abess::extract(
      fit_diag,
      support.size = k
    )


    beta_k <- as.numeric(
      model_k$beta
    )


    selected_k <- sort(
      which(
        abs(
          beta_k
        ) >
          1e-10
      )
    )


    models_diag[[k]] <-
      selected_k


    Xb_diag[, k] <-
      ols_fitted_values_diag(
        X = X_diag,
        y = y_diag,
        selected = selected_k
      )


    RSS_diag[k] <- sum(
      (
        y_diag -
          Xb_diag[, k]
      )^2
    )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## SCORE
  ## ==========================================================

  score_diag <- numeric(
    k_max_diag
  )


  for (
    k in
      seq_len(
        k_max_diag
      )
  ) {

    score_diag[k] <- sum(
      (
        Xb_diag[, k] -
          Xb_diag[, k_max_diag]
      )^2
    ) +
      1e-16
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## NOISE VARIANCE ESTIMATE
  ## ==========================================================

  sigma2_hat_diag <-
    RSS_diag[k_max_diag] /
    (
      n_diag -
        k_max_diag
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## LEVEL
  ## ==========================================================

  x_level_diag <-
    2 * log(
      p_diag
    ) +
    log(
      n_diag
    ) +
    1


  level_diag <- 4 *
    (
      sqrt(
        seq_len(
          k_max_diag
        )
      ) +
        sqrt(
          k_max_diag
        )
    )^2 *
    x_level_diag *
    sigma2_hat_diag


  ## ==========================================================
  ## RATIO
  ## ==========================================================

  ratio_diag <-
    score_diag /
    level_diag


  ## ==========================================================
  ## THRESHOLD ESTIMATE
  ##
  ## First k for which R(k) <= 1
  ## ==========================================================

  threshold_candidates <- which(
    ratio_diag[
      1:(
        k_max_diag -
          1
      )
    ] <= 1
  )


  if (
    length(
      threshold_candidates
    ) >
      0
  ) {

    threshold_size <-
      threshold_candidates[1]

  } else {

    threshold_size <-
      NA_integer_
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## SUPPORT AT TRUE SIZE
  ## ==========================================================

  support_at_true_size <-
    models_diag[[s_true_diag]]


  exact_support_true_size <-
    setequal(
      support_at_true_size,
      true_support_diag
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## SUPPORT AT THRESHOLD SIZE
  ## ==========================================================

  if (
    !is.na(
      threshold_size
    )
  ) {

    threshold_support <-
      models_diag[[threshold_size]]


    exact_threshold_support <-
      setequal(
        threshold_support,
        true_support_diag
      )

  } else {

    threshold_support <-
      integer(0)


    exact_threshold_support <-
      FALSE
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## OPTIONAL OUTPUT
  ## ==========================================================

  if (
    verbose
  ) {

    cat(
      "\nTarget SNR:",
      target_snr,
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "Realised SNR:",
      round(
        realised_snr_diag,
        4
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "Threshold estimate:",
      threshold_size,
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "R(1):",
      round(
        ratio_diag[1],
        5
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "R(2):",
      round(
        ratio_diag[2],
        5
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "R(3):",
      round(
        ratio_diag[3],
        5
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "R(4):",
      round(
        ratio_diag[4],
        5
      ),
      "\n"
    )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## RETURN
  ## ==========================================================

  return(
    list(

      target_snr =
        target_snr,

      realised_snr =
        realised_snr_diag,

      threshold_size =
        threshold_size,

      threshold_correct =
        !is.na(
          threshold_size
        ) &&
        threshold_size ==
          s_true_diag,

      ratio =
        ratio_diag,

      score =
        score_diag,

      level =
        level_diag,

      models =
        models_diag,

      support_at_true_size =
        support_at_true_size,

      exact_support_true_size =
        exact_support_true_size,

      threshold_support =
        threshold_support,

      exact_threshold_support =
        exact_threshold_support,

      gic_size =
        as.integer(
          fit_diag$best.size
        ),

      sigma =
        sigma_diag,

      sigma2_hat =
        sigma2_hat_diag
    )
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 7. COARSE SNR SEARCH
##
## Broad search first.
## ============================================================

snr_coarse <- unique(
  c(

    seq(
      from = 1,
      to = 20,
      by = 1
    ),

    seq(
      from = 25,
      to = 100,
      by = 5
    ),

    seq(
      from = 110,
      to = 300,
      by = 10
    )
  )
)


coarse_results <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(
    snr_coarse
  )
)


cat(
  "============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "COARSE SNR SEARCH\n"
)

cat(
  "============================================================\n\n"
)


for (
  ii in
    seq_along(
      snr_coarse
    )
) {

  current_snr <-
    snr_coarse[ii]


  cat(
    "Running SNR =",
    current_snr,
    "..."
  )


  coarse_results[[ii]] <-
    run_abess_threshold_snr(
      target_snr =
        current_snr,
      verbose =
        FALSE
    )


  cat(
    " threshold =",
    coarse_results[[ii]]$threshold_size,
    ifelse(
      coarse_results[[ii]]$threshold_correct,
      " CORRECT",
      " WRONG"
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


## ============================================================
## 8. COARSE SUMMARY TABLE
## ============================================================

coarse_table <- data.frame(

  SNR =
    snr_coarse,

  threshold_size =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$threshold_size
      }
    ),

  threshold_correct =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$threshold_correct
      }
    ),

  R1 =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$ratio[1]
      }
    ),

  R2 =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$ratio[2]
      }
    ),

  R3 =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$ratio[3]
      }
    ),

  R4 =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$ratio[4]
      }
    ),

  GIC_size =
    sapply(
      coarse_results,
      function(x) {
        x$gic_size
      }
    )
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "COARSE RESULTS\n"
)

cat(
  "============================================================\n\n"
)


print(
  coarse_table,
  digits = 5,
  row.names = FALSE
)


## ============================================================
## 9. FIND LOWEST SNR FROM WHICH THRESHOLD REMAINS CORRECT
##
## This is stronger than simply finding the first correct SNR.
##
## We want an SNR such that:
##
##   threshold is correct there
##   AND at every larger tested SNR.
## ============================================================

correct_coarse <-
  coarse_table$threshold_correct


works_from_here <- logical(
  length(
    correct_coarse
  )
)


for (
  ii in
    seq_along(
      correct_coarse
    )
) {

  works_from_here[ii] <-
    all(
      correct_coarse[
        ii:length(
          correct_coarse
        )
      ]
    )
}


transition_index <- which(
  works_from_here
)[1]


if (
  length(
    transition_index
  ) ==
    0
) {

  transition_index <-
    NA_integer_
}


## ============================================================
## 10. DEFINE FINE SEARCH REGION
## ============================================================

if (
  is.na(
    transition_index
  )
) {

  cat(
    "\nThreshold never became consistently correct over the tested SNR range.\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Increase the maximum SNR and rerun.\n"
  )


  fine_table <- NULL


} else if (
  transition_index ==
    1
) {

  cat(
    "\nThreshold already works at the smallest tested SNR.\n"
  )


  fine_table <- NULL


} else {

  lower_snr <-
    coarse_table$SNR[
      transition_index -
        1
    ]


  upper_snr <-
    coarse_table$SNR[
      transition_index
    ]


  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )


  cat(
    "COARSE TRANSITION FOUND\n"
  )


  cat(
    "============================================================\n\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Last coarse SNR before consistent success:",
    lower_snr,
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "First coarse SNR with consistent success:",
    upper_snr,
    "\n\n"
  )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 11. FINE SEARCH
  ##
  ## Search in increments of 0.1
  ## ==========================================================

  snr_fine <- seq(
    from = lower_snr,
    to = upper_snr,
    by = 0.1
  )


  fine_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      snr_fine
    )
  )


  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )


  cat(
    "FINE SNR SEARCH\n"
  )


  cat(
    "============================================================\n\n"
  )


  for (
    ii in
      seq_along(
        snr_fine
      )
  ) {

    current_snr <-
      snr_fine[ii]


    fine_results[[ii]] <-
      run_abess_threshold_snr(
        target_snr =
          current_snr,
        verbose =
          FALSE
      )


    cat(
      "SNR =",
      sprintf(
        "%.1f",
        current_snr
      ),
      "| threshold =",
      fine_results[[ii]]$threshold_size,
      ifelse(
        fine_results[[ii]]$threshold_correct,
        "CORRECT",
        "WRONG"
      ),
      "\n"
    )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 12. FINE TABLE
  ## ==========================================================

  fine_table <- data.frame(

    SNR =
      snr_fine,

    threshold_size =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$threshold_size
        }
      ),

    threshold_correct =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$threshold_correct
        }
      ),

    R1 =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$ratio[1]
        }
      ),

    R2 =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$ratio[2]
        }
      ),

    R3 =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$ratio[3]
        }
      ),

    R4 =
      sapply(
        fine_results,
        function(x) {
          x$ratio[4]
        }
      )
  )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 13. FIND FINE TRANSITION
  ## ==========================================================

  correct_fine <-
    fine_table$threshold_correct


  fine_works_from_here <- logical(
    length(
      correct_fine
    )
  )


  for (
    ii in
      seq_along(
        correct_fine
      )
  ) {

    fine_works_from_here[ii] <-
      all(
        correct_fine[
          ii:length(
            correct_fine
          )
        ]
      )
  }


  fine_transition_index <- which(
    fine_works_from_here
  )[1]


  if (
    length(
      fine_transition_index
    ) ==
      0
  ) {

    fine_transition_index <-
      NA_integer_
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 14. FINAL TRANSITION RESULT
  ## ==========================================================

  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )


  cat(
    "FINAL THRESHOLD TRANSITION\n"
  )


  cat(
    "============================================================\n\n"
  )


  if (
    !is.na(
      fine_transition_index
    )
  ) {

    critical_snr <-
      fine_table$SNR[
        fine_transition_index
      ]


    cat(
      "Lowest tested SNR from which the threshold\n"
    )


    cat(
      "correctly recovers s =",
      s_true_diag,
      "and remains correct at larger tested SNRs:\n\n"
    )


    cat(
      "SNR approximately =",
      critical_snr,
      "\n\n"
    )


    if (
      fine_transition_index >
        1
    ) {

      cat(
        "At SNR =",
        fine_table$SNR[
          fine_transition_index -
            1
        ],
        "the threshold estimate was",
        fine_table$threshold_size[
          fine_transition_index -
            1
        ],
        "\n"
      )
    }


    cat(
      "At SNR =",
      critical_snr,
      "the threshold estimate was",
      fine_table$threshold_size[
        fine_transition_index
      ],
      "\n"
    )


  } else {

    cat(
      "No stable transition was found in the fine search interval.\n"
    )
  }
}


## ============================================================
## 15. PLOT THRESHOLD ESTIMATE AGAINST SNR
## ============================================================

plot(
  coarse_table$SNR,
  coarse_table$threshold_size,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  log = "x",
  xlab = "Signal-to-noise ratio",
  ylab = "Threshold estimated model size",
  main = paste0(
    "Threshold Model Size Across SNR: True size = ",
    s_true_diag
  ),
  ylim = c(
    1,
    k_max_diag
  )
)


abline(
  h = s_true_diag,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)


legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    "Threshold estimate",
    paste(
      "True size =",
      s_true_diag
    )
  ),
  lty = c(
    1,
    2
  ),
  pch = c(
    19,
    NA
  ),
  lwd = c(
    1,
    2
  ),
  bty = "n"
)


## ============================================================
## 16. PLOT R(k) FOR k = 1,2,3,4 AGAINST SNR
##
## This lets you see WHY the threshold starts working.
## ============================================================

matplot(
  coarse_table$SNR,
  coarse_table[
    ,
    c(
      "R1",
      "R2",
      "R3",
      "R4"
    )
  ],
  type = "b",
  pch = 1:4,
  lty = 1:4,
  log = "xy",
  xlab = "Signal-to-noise ratio",
  ylab = "Score / level",
  main = "Threshold Ratios Across SNR"
)


abline(
  h = 1,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)


legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    "R(1)",
    "R(2)",
    "R(3)",
    "R(4)",
    "Threshold = 1"
  ),
  lty = c(
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    2
  ),
  pch = c(
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    NA
  ),
  bty = "n"
)
```
